OpenClaw 2026.11.8

Highlights

  • Privacy and safety: Keep view-once Signal attachments out of agent input, block workspace Azure redirects, redact reflected ClawHub credentials, and reject newline injection in Windows commands. (#196841, #202031, #187625, #190547) Thanks @drobison00, @mmaps, @Alix-007, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @Winoren.
  • Conversation continuity: Keep Claude CLI history and warm follow-ups usable across resets, message-tool replies, fallback, and ACP process restarts. (#197536, #197735, #197295, #198426, #189500) Related #165954, #190216 Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @brandonulrich, @mariorivas1, @zeroaltitude, @VACInc, @vincentkoc, and @masatohoshino.
  • Reliable answers: Deliver final answers after interrupted Telegram drafts, reasoning and tool calls, or steering without replacing child answers with model notices or duplicating replies. (#181508, #194896, #196769, #202540, #189852) Related #197134, #194891, #202482 Thanks @blackapodidae, @obviyus, @kybrcore, @razethion, @Hidetsugu55, and @YangManBOBO.
  • Dependable automations: Finish silent and empty-checklist runs correctly, preserve edited jobs’ originating chats, and let scheduled work use its own scratch and delivery history. (#197618, #202390, #186833, #199197, #188848) Related #197571, #202350, #199194 Thanks @obviyus, @allie-offsite, @herosuncy, @fransqaas, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, and @RomneyDa.
  • Safer, lighter upgrades: Avoid repeated database copies, reclaim old runtimes and snapshots, and preserve complete SQLite recovery captures even when backups are slow. (#193941, #197833, #191196, #199654, #192406) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev and @dankarization.
  • Model access and authentication: Keep refreshable OAuth models available, wait for peer refreshes, preserve MCP sign-in during network outages, and restore worker-local model switching and ChatGPT version negotiation. (#191789, #192906, #196055, #196414, #197507, #202427) Related #197168, #197169 Thanks @VACInc, @jalehman, @sallyom, @obviyus, and @zijunl.

Changes

This maintenance release concentrates on the fixes below. Upcoming compatibility deadlines are listed after the fixes.

Fixes

  • Command and reply boundaries: Keep prose mentioning /queue intact, discard blank outbound attachments, and retain completed answers after earlier message sends or queued turns. (#188571, #189290, #188900, #189240) Related #188570 Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @sunlit-deng, @VACInc, and @HermanZeng.
  • Conversation ordering and visibility: Keep older commentary ahead of unrelated input, show message-tool updates from child-report turns, and deliver queued-run start events after their chats are linked. (#188658, #196033, #195193) Related #188641, #195121 Thanks @RomneyDa, @hannesrudolph, @jalehman, @saariuslystoned, and @obviyus.
  • Subagent delivery and wakeups: Report delivered sessions_send messages accurately, drain passive notices on resumes and tool handoffs, and give utility fallbacks independent deadlines. (#196034, #197725, #197692, #191653) Related #191600 Thanks @jalehman, @obviyus, @gouyu-hou, and @Marvinthebored.
  • Shared and ACP sessions: Preserve running shared-session access across list updates, read and search configured ACP transcript stores, and stop interrupted ACP startup cleanly. (#194129, #164993, #196130, #191707) Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @RomneyDa, @MertBasar0, @fuller-stack-dev, @RXQ6, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Alix-007.
  • History fidelity: Keep synthetic lifecycle rows out of Claude CLI replies, preserve repaired tool-error states, and include questions in legacy HTML exports. (#189210, #189580, #197310) Related #189181, #189577, #197304 Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @RomneyDa, @Linux2010, @obviyus, @kir1ll, @gouyu-hou, and @Jo2234.
  • Claude CLI tools and latency: List node-hosted skills and audience-gated memory tools, and avoid slow follow-ups caused by native rollout rotation. (#189406, #197274, #194902) Related #189380, #197273 Thanks @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, @mdarapour, @etzelm, and @VACInc.
  • Codex workspaces and goals: Refresh inherited workspace instructions on the next turn, keep Doctor responsive while scanning native assignments, and continue local Codex goals without requiring operator roles. (#191439, #189248, #194724) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Oldrich333 and @VACInc.
  • Code Mode recovery: Recover transient QuickJS initialization failures, keep Code Mode usable after read-only workers retire, bound repeated failures, expose queued follow-ups, and retain compacted shell output. (#191952, #201547, #195754, #199568) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Telegram routing and history: Keep private bound topics on their ACP sessions, retain non-forum group replies in history, route cached context and cron notices to their owning topics, and retry ambiguous final sends. (#190516, #189231, #195214, #192779) Related #166323 Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @GodBlf, @SergeiAug, @antontuzov, @obviyus, and @InsanusMokrassar.
  • Discord delivery and controls: Retain background command results in auto-threads, use real Discord reply anchors, restore button feedback, settle aborted REST requests, and tolerate already-removed commands during deployment. (#190577, #196963, #190083, #187555, #194150) Related #179870, #196962, #187537, #194149 Thanks @hanamizuki, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @pfrederiksen, @yy19971996, @Schnup03, and @ooiuuii.
  • Feishu messages: Acknowledge follow-ups during active work, retry transient sends without duplicates, reject synthetic reply anchors, and restore reactions when chat type is absent. (#188100, #188837, #177297, #190515) Related #167270 Thanks @joshavant, @litang9, @can2049, @obviyus, @shengshuyuan, and @josephjyzeng.
  • Channel media and mentions: Send Vorbis audio with the correct type in Feishu and WhatsApp, avoid WhatsApp replies to unrelated phone-number digits, and preserve Tlon lists and punctuated bot mentions. (#199579, #197080, #189448, #197057, #197037) Related #199578, #197060, #197056, #197021 Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @Jo2234, and @elbourne12345.
  • Teams, Mattermost, Matrix, and SMS: Deliver the remainder of rejected Teams streams, retain Mattermost posts with link previews, forget removed Matrix credentials, and preserve SMS callback capacity across uploads. (#202368, #193836, #186140, #194352) Related #193811 Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @RomneyDa, @MertBasar0, @obviyus, @kaguranananana, @elio-usl, @wr-web, and @mmaps.
  • Meet and transcription: Follow all Calendar event pages, retain Google Meet document bodies when transcript entries are skipped, and report Whisper HTTP and download failures without losing transcripts. (#194103, #175130, #194478, #194588) Related #194092, #175128 Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @AmelioMansour, @KhanCold, and @zhangguiping-xydt.
  • Voice and playback: Preserve spaces in streamed Talk transcripts, stop claiming cancelled consult work finished, avoid repacing GPT-Live audio, and play M4V attachments using the right codecs. (#190271, #191950, #189029, #190169) Related #190244, #189070, #189012, #172162 Thanks @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, @noelillinger, @anmol0b, @Solvely-Colin, @Kambrian, @restalfep, and @fhgffy.
  • Provider reasoning and streaming: Preserve OpenRouter reasoning through cold startup and OpenAI-compatible reasoning across tool calls, accept multiline streamed JSON, and handle read-only custom-provider streams. (#196462, #202774, #195019, #191724) Related #196142, #191702 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @RomneyDa, @MertBasar0, @hehuang139, @obviyus, @609NFT, @saariuslystoned, and @jason-allen-oneal.
  • Provider request compatibility: Honor Model Studio output limits and DeepInfra thinking-off settings, use the correct Grok 4.6 context window without unsupported temperature, and avoid placeholder-filled optional tool arguments on ClawRouter. (#189870, #192979, #192927, #192958, #196083) Related #192978, #192926, #192957 Thanks @synthalorian, @ooiuuii, @obviyus, and @jalehman.
  • Provider errors and retries: Retry empty llmman tool-followup turns, return visible Muse quota and sign-in errors, stop short retries for exhausted credits, and skip credential retries for missing models. (#187769, #195148, #201997, #188290, #189716) Related #195072 Thanks @ericcurtin, @saariuslystoned, @obviyus, @LinzeShi, @ooiuuii, and @teddytennant.
  • Image models and local inference: Use supported legacy OpenAI image sizes, allow single-image Gemini edits through LiteLLM, and isolate each llama.cpp caller’s cancellation during shared model loads. (#190058, #190082, #194494) Thanks @xiajiahang, @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, @shuisadev, and @SunnyShu0925.
  • Catalogs and credential recovery: Keep OpenCode Go models during endpoint outages, resolve project and plugin-discovered models correctly, refresh saved logins even when settings writes are refused, and honor earlier quota resets and refreshed xAI expiry. (#193234, #197238, #169539, #187013, #189427, #191464) Related #193194, #169205, #186949 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @1052326311, @theimmortal68, @obviyus, @ericcaiwx-star, @AVCarp, @daniel-lxs, and @Glucksberg.
  • Long sessions and usage: Respect configured large context windows for Gateway-method turns, allow healthy proxy streams beyond 16 MiB, preserve web-search preferences, and parse Claude, z.ai, and BytePlus usage accurately. (#195307, #197842, #189889, #190449, #190342, #188762) Thanks @saariuslystoned, @obviyus, @nocodet888-arch, @vyctorbrzezowski, @synthalorian, @wangmiao0668000666, @tzy-17, and @rrmars.
  • Worker inference: Keep device-worker plugin models alive across generation changes, prevent offered web-search tools from failing turns before inference, and run infer model requests through the state-owning Gateway. (#197314, #194540, #198141) Related #197241, #182647, #198108 Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @bautheac, @arcabotai, @cursoragent, @migelizaga-rgb, and @alfredjbclaw.
  • Worker setup and networking: Refresh Linux enrollment certificates, mount comma-containing workspace paths, preserve missing-module startup diagnostics, use configured hosts for GitHub readiness, and honor TLS when probing SSH endpoints. (#188802, #195304, #194935, #192541, #190102) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @galiniliev, @shuisadev, @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, and @zhangguiping-xydt.
  • Gateway shutdown and restart: Resume channel threads after graceful restarts, finish shutdown after plugin retirement or delayed sidecar cleanup, give child settlement its cleanup budget, and release history and pricing resources when stopping. (#188402, #198652, #197883, #190134, #193614, #189033) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @etzelm and @RomneyDa.
  • Automation ownership and settlement: Refuse ownerless operator edits, resolve agent-less jobs through the system agent, let jobs read their own delivery receipts, finalize one-shot jobs on PostgreSQL 16, and avoid detached reply turns from script sends. (#198621, #197917, #190598, #194384, #189189) Related #197905, #189145 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @daniel-lxs, @DasX, @vincentkoc, @chelsealong, @obviyus, and @GoatInAHat.
  • Scheduled updates and workboard: Keep images in scheduled chat updates without cluttering the thread, and prevent superseded workboard runs from completing cards with stale results. (#196602, #198456) Related #198450 Thanks @vincentkoc and @daniel-lxs.
  • Doctor and upgrade recovery: Retain useful metadata during inspections, avoid restore advice for cancelled inspections, skip unrelated captures before hashing, and continue updates when a pre-Doctor ledger generation cannot be read. (#202984, #192407, #193622) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @dankarization, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Doctor consent and model settings: Require repair consent before unattended plugin downloads, preserve CLI-runtime model pins in replace mode, and park the Gateway safely when agent databases use older schemas. (#191523, #197412, #194599) Related #191420, #197403, #194580 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @etzelm, @brandonulrich, @marcio-GOT, and @pawel-kowalczyk.
  • Backup selection and restoration: Resolve symlinks and parent segments before selecting backup archives, and restore Git backups containing Unicode line separators. (#197688, #188522) Related #197685, #188519 Thanks @RomneyDa, @Malpin07, @obviyus, and @dubr1k.
  • Plugin installation and packaging: Keep configured executables working after updates, preserve plugin APIs and exports in trimmed or large standalone builds, and support portable plugin-state keys on PostgreSQL. (#191693, #193624, #194956, #188693) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Docker and Kubernetes: Preserve bundled-plugin SDK imports, pass build arguments to the correct Docker stage, and fail Kubernetes initialization when configuration seeding fails. (#181974, #193041, #198983) Related #181950, #193039, #198981 Thanks @grootbro, @obviyus, @Card4Philippe, @tssala23, @llbohacll, and @sallyom.
  • Memory retention and control: Preserve inline notes during MEMORY.md compaction, honor the Memory Core dreaming opt-out with another memory-slot owner, reclaim disk space after reindexing, and restore deep recall for English object questions. (#164089, #188950, #197230, #191384) Related #163900, #197216 Thanks @GoldArowana, @obviyus, @astra-openclaw, @etzelm, @ericcaiwx-star, @unitedyachtclubs, and @heithmurray.
  • Knowledge search and imports: Return complete large inventories, report real write access for new stores, search terms ending in a period, and retain Markdown links with encoded hashes or imported page targets. (#195215, #192073, #192311, #191791, #199626) Related #195060 Thanks @andone-07, @saariuslystoned, @VACInc, @Yigtwxx, @obviyus, @zhangguiping-xydt, and @Leon-SK668.
  • Imported chats and web content: Refresh ChatGPT transcripts containing Notes markers, preserve literal HTML text and pasted links after Markdown reference citations, resolve article links through base tags, and report unresponsive SearXNG engines rather than empty results. (#193173, #191913, #190710, #189714, #190619) Related #193161, #182418 Thanks @KhanCold, @obviyus, @zhangguiping-xydt, @loading2332, @Yigtwxx, and @geekforlife.
  • Browser startup and tabs: Connect configured extension relays at HTTP startup, avoid occupied CDP ports, tolerate long Linux temporary paths and large macOS process listings, and keep tab listing usable when Chrome refuses attachment. (#190157, #194295, #196778, #188901, #191578) Related #194236, #188889 Thanks @trukhinyuri, @Abinithishkumarprabakaran, @obviyus, @iroda-syswfc, @vincentkoc, @shakkernerd, and @copystring.
  • Computer control: Recover CUA recording after resource initialization failures, restore desktop element references with CUA 0.37, and recheck queued desktop launch requests before starting apps. (#192001, #190700, #198013) Thanks @vincentkoc, @huidongchen148, @obviyus, and @joshavant.
  • Control UI editing: Keep dictated text across focus changes, preserve custom-model drafts through background updates, validate channel settings before Save, retain unfinished map entries, and prevent IME commits from submitting credential drafts. (#197852, #191045, #182085, #182063, #195483) Related #197843 Thanks @RomneyDa, @jacobtomlinson, @MertBasar0, @wr-web, @obviyus, @digitalfrost84, @Alix-007, @AmelioMansour, and @wangmiao0668000666.
  • Control UI access: Recover chat links with unknown query parameters, retain browser approval across OpenClaw ID sign-out and sign-in, and open conversation terminals in multi-agent fleets. (#194864, #194354, #190059) Related #194859 Thanks @MertBasar0, @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @jalehman, and @ArcueidMP.
  • macOS integration: Keep output containing invalid UTF-8, stop closed dashboards reconnecting after native authentication refusal, preserve successful command results when detached daemons outlive cleanup, and bundle native dependencies before signing. (#188202, #185963, #185636, #197383) Related #187601 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @anmol0b, @etzelm, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @jalehman.
  • Interrupt handling: Stop bulk session imports, skill updates, image output, video descriptions, and channel shutdown promptly after cancellation; interrupted progress commands no longer emit late success. (#197508, #198163, #191176, #194251, #198019, #197617) Related #198162 Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, @masatohoshino, @Alix-007, and @SunnyShu0925.
  • Onboarding and local workspaces: Restore Quick start after interrupted onboarding, ask for an agent model after utility-only provider setup, honor selected state directories in templates, initialize isolated workspaces on Windows, and ignore empty configuration-builder options. (#191550, #196058, #195448, #190281, #190896) Related #191549, #195576, #188895 Thanks @daniel-lxs, @yxshee, @HootRock, @KhanCold, and @obviyus.
  • Workspace synchronization and proxy access: Exclude pnpm, NuGet, and Convex caches from workspace results, handle stale worker PIDs during warm capture, allow bounded local HTTP access through the secret proxy, and issue certificates for long allowed hostnames. (#188089, #202327, #193653, #186765, #153661) Related #188068, #181524, #152529 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @shakkernerd, @ericcurtin, @nikosml, @alter, @obviyus, and @dh-js.
  • Plugin state and tool grants: Keep plugin state readable when writes are refused, release MCP grants after warm CLI turns, refresh native command channels when their registry changes, and let project chats publish their own checkout. (#190320, #191980, #199743, #195039) Related #199612 Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @jacobtomlinson, @vincentkoc, @555aaditya, @obviyus, and @eliavb43.
  • File access and local questions: Keep blank Markdown-field writes readable, descend correctly through JSONL wildcard paths, and keep multiline TUI side questions ephemeral. (#190644, #189960, #190524) Related #189957, #190469 Thanks @LinzeShi, @obviyus, @jerome-queck, and @yetval.
  • Responsiveness and memory use: Avoid transcript-body reads for archive listings, repeated scans for filtered Knowledge queries, repeated widget syntax validation, unnecessary Doctor header reads and GitHub-readiness database copies, and retained configuration or X-stream memory. (#192732, #193209, #189903, #188789, #188343, #192545, #191161) Related #191116 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @sogav21, @cursoragent, and @hpyhandsome.
  • Update diagnostics and authentication status: Find operator agents on PATH during failed-update triage and stop showing authentication recovery advice after restrictions expire. (#194058, #176331) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @TheRealUnknownSoldier and @zhangguiping-xydt.
  • Steering and model defaults: Keep steering context at its originally admitted position on Responses routes and respect agent-specific model configuration in llm-task. (#198736, #188758) Thanks @obviyus and @Yigtwxx.
  • Attachments and older devices: Retain managed images across sandboxed turns and list cameras from legacy Windows nodes. (#195992, #190685) Related #181348 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @SC-10749 and @adamant064.
  • Automation expiry: Expire automation sessions without hydrating unrelated entries. (#191843) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Plugin installation: Retain unchanged verified ClawHub installs, resolve installed bundled surfaces to built files, and retain prepared alias identity through discovery. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Catalog lifetimes: Release superseded remote catalog generations, omit unlisted runtime models on first read, and reuse catalog hook manifest inventory. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Subscription routes: Preserve subscription chat across catalog route overlays. Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @RomneyDa, and @MertBasar0.
  • Tool replay: Preserve readable tool prefixes across replay and isolate unreadable Anthropic tool descriptors. Thanks @RomneyDa, @jacobtomlinson, and @MertBasar0.
  • Usage prices: Resolve prices before retaining placeholder usage costs. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • State safeguards: Retain state when Gateway ownership is refused, retain metadata through deferred inspection, and drain captured agent aliases before rollback. Thanks @RomneyDa and @etzelm.
  • Memory tools: Show memory tool call shapes so agents can invoke available Knowledge operations correctly. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Mattermost buttons: Deliver ordinary button clicks once. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Installation guidance: Retain actionable shell setup in the final installation summary. Thanks @etzelm and @RomneyDa.

Highlights

  • Conversation recovery: Recover interrupted replies and child results across Gateway restarts without losing pending work. (#198905, #201544, #200924, #200967) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @galiniliev, and @vincentkoc.
  • Reliable automations: Let an automation’s owner conversation repair failures, and distinguish recovered or intentionally skipped runs from genuine failures.   • Smoother updates: Finish Git and package updates through schema changes, busy databases, and retained recovery state instead of stopping before or after the new release starts. (#201600, #201463, #201545, #201330) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Responsive Gateway: Keep chats, readiness checks, and unrelated sessions responsive during slow filesystem operations, large recovery packs, and page extraction. (#191236, #201248, #200623, #200925) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Browser pairing: Pair another browser with a short code approved on the Gateway host, with clearer instructions while approval is pending. (#191513, #200905) Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @jalehman, and @etzelm.
  • Current ChatGPT catalogs: Discover newly available subscription models without waiting for another OpenClaw release and keep sign-in discovery independent of npm. (#201130, #201493) Related #201480 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @daniel-lxs.

Changes

  • Knowledge search: Find current records using superseded wording and match canonically equivalent Unicode keyword spellings. (#193742, #195092) Related #193054, #195031 Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @Linux2010, @jalehman, and @saariuslystoned.
  • Talk transcription: Use a saved Deepgram, ElevenLabs, or Mistral API key for live transcription. (#199858) Related #199684 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Session control — breaking SDK change: Move session-keyed setActiveEmbeddedRun(...) registrations into the host-provided runAttempt callback and retain their exact cleanup function; unadmitted registration now reports SESSION_CONTROLLER_ADMISSION_REQUIRED. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
  • Gateway methods — breaking SDK change: Replace mutable chatAbortControllers and chatQueuedTurns access with dispatchGatewayMethod from openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-method-runtime, declaring contracts.gatewayMethodDispatch: ["authenticated-request"] in the plugin manifest; existing caller permissions still apply. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @johan-eilertsen, and @jalehman.
  • Start observation — breaking SDK change: Update AgentTurnStartOwner.observe() consumers from expiresAtMs to startDeadlineAtMs; this is the execution-start deadline, not the execution timeout, and has no compatibility alias. See docs/plugins/sdk-migration.md for migration guidance. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman.

OpenClaw 2026.11.6

Highlights

  • Smoother upgrades: bridge the 2026.11.5 updater to the current release path and validate staged plugin dependencies correctly on Windows. (#200662, #200595) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @desksk.
  • More resilient conversations: keep subagent and background turns running through configuration edits, and deliver final answers when a Gateway restart interrupted sending. (#200516, #200553) Thanks @obviyus and @RomneyDa.
  • Lighter, more responsive Gateway: reduce startup memory pressure and resident memory on constrained hosts, defer unused local credential runtimes, and keep plugin tool discovery from blocking the Gateway. (#191272, #198194, #188033) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ctbritt, and @obviyus.
  • Reliable long-running model turns: preserve append-only provider history, exact Responses tool-argument bytes, and final replies from long, tool-heavy Claude CLI turns. (#197874, #200020, #200501) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, @boeingchoco, @n1hility, and @Trinity-AI-Coder.
  • Better conversation continuity: keep loaded chat history visible during compaction and allow iOS Talk turns to continue beyond the previous 30-second cutoff. (#199534, #163474) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, @Olli0103, and @keysersozeh.

Changes

  • ChatGPT setup and models: update Sign in with ChatGPT labels and Business usage guidance, refresh bundled Codex support for newer ChatGPT models, and restore model catalog requests through the inference relay. (#196330, #200784, #197768) Thanks @stevenlee-oai, @hannesrudolph, @VACInc, and @bdjben.

Fixes

  • Git updates: skip unnecessary declaration builds during ordinary Git updates while preserving explicit build settings and release-build behavior. (#189463) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Responses recovery: recover saved conversation item conflicts before output and across runs without replaying completed effects. (#199757, #199896, #200020) Authored by @steipete.
  • Subagent results: retain results through Gateway restarts and resume requester settlement without replaying already-consumed results; keep actual delivery failures distinct from successful consumption. (#199695, #199868, #200249) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @yousan, @Marvinthebored, @sallyom, and @obviyus.
  • Large file reads: stop scanning after the requested text page instead of loading the whole file, while preserving continuation and text-encoding handling. (#186992) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @MoerAI and @JasonBuildAI.
  • Credential handling: redact inline environment credentials in configuration reads and preserve SecretRef-backed skill API keys instead of replacing references with plaintext. (#190618, #200539) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @yetval, @obviyus, and @tommyjoseph.
